decisions.reason: The mitred lever family stayed on the website through 2024 and is part of a coordinated design range, and architectural hardware lines in Germany typically run for many years once tooling is in place.
It was moved to its own dedicated page in 2024, which shows growing emphasis and fits the firm's push toward barrier-free, multifunctional solutions.
It is still listed in 2024 with low visibility, but long product lifecycles and sunk tooling and certification costs make withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection keeps its own page and is prominently promoted with German Design Award and iF Design Award results, making it a flagship line.
